label: R&D personnel by sector of performance, professional position and sex

extension.description: Research and development (R&D) personnel statistics measure all persons directly engaged in R&D activities or providing direct services to them, such as researchers, technicians and R&D support staff. Data are compiled in line with the Frascati Manual and cover annual counts and full-time equivalents by sector of performance, professional position and sex.

annotation.text: Eurostat; Organisation for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD)
